name: Let Me Save You! Your Faithful Companion
source:
You're given plenty of things in this game, including Cornelia. But whether she stays with you depends on what you do...

[From [url=https://sonia-leong.livejournal.com/200681.html]The Official Website[/url]]
translation:
游戏会把许多东西交到你手中，其中也包括科妮莉亚。但她是否会留在你身边，取决于你的行动……

[译自 [url=https://sonia-leong.livejournal.com/200681.html]官方网站[/url]]
